The challenge
## Every company runs on processes. Few _truly understand_ them.
###  Static diagrams don't keep you compliant 
Tools like Visio capture a process once, but they can't enforce standards, track approvals, or prove an audit trail. When a regulator or auditor asks how a process actually runs today, a desktop diagram isn't an answer. 
###  Bottlenecks hide in plain sight 
Teams know a process feels slow, but the exact cause is often unclear. Without real process data, improvement efforts can focus on the wrong issue. 
###  AI without process context is guessing 
Agents and copilots need to understand your steps, rules, service level agreements, exceptions, and approval paths. Without that context, the burden falls on your team to correct their mistakes. 
###  Every team works from a different version 
When process models live in scattered files, each department ends up with its own copy and its own interpretation. Without a single, shared view, alignment breaks down and no one can trust which version is current. 
The organizations that will win with AI aren’t the ones with the fanciest models, they’re the ones whose processes are clear, measured, and trustworthy enough  
for humans and machines to build on together.
The mindzie thesis
## Turn your process data into decisions.
Sign up for free and start mining, analyzing, and improving your workflows in minutes.
[ Create Your Free Account ](https://signup.mindziestudio.com/)
The platform
## From real _process insight_ to _continuous improvement_
mindzie is a process intelligence platform that gives enterprise teams a clearer way to understand how work moves across systems, teams, and decisions. Instead of relying on static maps or scattered reports, leaders can see where processes follow the plan, where they drift, and where action is needed.
The result is a dynamic view of your operations that helps you reinforce best practices, eliminate roadblocks, and embrace new opportunities.
###  Understand 
Model it, then see it run 
mindzie unites business process modeling and process mining in a single platform, so the process you design and the process that actually runs live in the same place. Build the model, then read event logs to see how work moves and find bottlenecks.
  * BPMN 2.0 process modeling and design
  * Process mining from live event logs
  * Planned vs. actual workflow comparison
  * Root-cause and variant analysis


###  Improve 
Drive measurable change 
Move from insight to action. mindzie tracks live process performance, highlights what needs attention, and helps teams act urgently.
  * Operational insights and KPIs
  * Real-time process monitoring
  * Service level agreement and risk alerts
  * Alerts in Teams, Slack, and email


###  Transform 
Build an AI-ready backbone 
mindzie provides AI process intelligence so agents, copilots, and automation tools can work from real process rules and contexts.
  * Process context for AI agents
  * Approved process model
  * Business rules and approval paths
  * Audit trails for AI-supported decisions


[ Get started with the free version ](https://signup.mindziestudio.com/)
Core capabilities
## One integrated platform to _transform_ your business processes
###  Process Mining 
Map out your workflow 
Discover real workflows from system event logs, including every case, variant, bottleneck, rework loop, and exception.
[ Learn more ](https://mindzie.com/platform/process-mining-software/)
###  Object Centric Process Mining 
Follow work across every related object 
Analyze processes that span related objects such as orders, invoices, shipments, tickets, and claims. Model them once in Data Designer and compare every perspective in one project.
[ Learn more ](https://mindzie.com/platform/process-mining-software/#object-centric-process-mining)
###  Business Process Modeling 
Build effective processes with BPMN 2.0 
Design, document, and govern process models in BPMN 2.0, then compare them against how work actually happens.
[ Learn more ](https://mindzie.com/platform/bpmn-modeling-software/)
###  Task Mining 
Find the work your systems miss 
Capture desktop-level activity to reveal patterns such as manual work, repeated steps, and productivity gaps that system data alone cannot explain.
[ Learn more ](https://mindzie.com/platform/task-mining-software/)
